divisions.label: 16U
divisions.eligibility: Ages 6–16 on December 31, 2026; younger players may play up. Choose one bracket.

format.label: Rotating-partner round robin
format.description: Register individually; doubles partners rotate between rounds and each player earns an individual standing.

roundRobin.scoring: One game to the target score; review the serving/scoring convention at the player briefing.

format.gamesDescription: The documented 5-, 8-, 9- and 10-player draws provide four round-robin games per player, followed by a medal game for qualifiers.
tiebreakers: Head-to-head wins against tied players as opponents.
Point differential in games between tied players.
Point differential against the players immediately above them.
Total points scored; review unresolved advancement ties with the director.
medalRules: One pool of 8 or 9: gold 1st + 4th vs 2nd + 3rd; bronze 5th + 8th vs 6th + 7th. Ninth place finishes after round robin.
Two pools of 5: gold A1 + B2 vs B1 + A2; bronze A3 + B4 vs B3 + A4. Fifth place in each pool finishes after round robin.
Gold-game winners earn gold, runners-up silver, bronze-game winners bronze. Smaller fields need a director-confirmed medal draw.
turnoutRules: Five-player pools: four games and one rest round per player. Eight-player four-game draw: no rest rounds. Nine-player draw: one rest round per player.
Ten players: two reviewed pools of five. Other counts need a reviewed inclusive schedule before play.

policies.weather: Weather decisions are made 24 hours before the tournament. Same-day indoor backup: Lake Marion Community Center gymnasium, 3–6 PM ET. No separate makeup date.
policies.minimumEnrollment: At least 8 players across both brackets. If a bracket has fewer than 5, decide whether to combine or cancel it 3 days before the tournament.
policies.waiver: A parent or guardian must complete the NGA one-time waiver and accept the event policies.

payments.reconciliation: Match every registration to its NGA Stripe invoice. Confirm actual paid/refund/dispute evidence before changing payment status. MVF allocation: 20% of the $50 resident base plus the entire $10 nonresident surcharge; the organizer covers processing fees. This is an event-production agreement, not a platform transaction fee.

operations.director: Coach Sam Morris — verify event-day coverage
